newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude slips in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude slips in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil slipped slightly in late U.S. paper trading on Monday, traders said.
Five partial July Brent cargoes changed hands at $19.45 a barrel, down two cents from the settlement of London's IPE.
June/July Brent traded at plus 18 cents, plus 19 cents and plus 20 cents a barrel, confirming the intermonth uptick.
Earlier June/July deals were done between plus 10 cents and plus 16 cents.
July/August was talked at plus eight to eleven cents, while August/September was pegged around plus five to 10 cents a barrel.
